concerns.text: Task T003 requires downloading real ACE SWICS and WIND composition CDF files, but the Constitution (VI) mandates raw composition measurements be stored unchanged. No open, verified source for these CDF files exists, and the plan explicitly falls back to a synthetic dataset pending amendment. Consequently the task cannot be completed as written until an amendment provides a real data source or permits synthetic data for this step.

Task T012’s verification expects the final report JSON to contain `source_type: "Real"`. If the pipeline runs with the synthetic dataset (the only currently available data), this will violate Constitution Principle VI (Composition Data Integrity) and produce a misleading provenance claim. The task must either make `source_type` conditional on the data provenance or be revised to avoid asserting "Real" when synthetic data are used.
